title: From Hong Kong Phones to Solar Installations in Arusha
conflicts: Revenue: $6.8m for 2012 (How We Made It in Africa citing Forbes) against about $8m (TRUE Africa 2015, African Leadership Magazine 2022); both given with attribution. The $150,000 at 18 is turnover in one source and profit in another; story gives turnover and notes the other. First business at 15 was vouchers (Ngowi) or phones (TRUE Africa), and the $1,800 funded phones (Ngowi) or solar exports (TRUE Africa); story follows Ngowi's own account.
notes: Mostly profile journalism; Ngowi's own words come from a 2013 Ventures Africa interview, cited from a full reprint on the Michuzi blog because the original page could not be found, and a 2014 How We Made It in Africa Q&A. Forbes returns 403 and is not cited. The 2009 warehouse robbery is single-sourced and attributed. Quote stance: affirms.
